description: The Antevo Tremor Index over time, oldest first: each reading's week, level, how many times a normal Friday it was, its status (Calm, Elevated, High or Severe) and the split into strengthening and weakening, with the peak of the period. weeks is how many Fridays, 1 to 1600 (default 52; the record starts in 1997); until (YYYY-MM-DD) ends the period in that week instead of the latest, so weeks=78 with until=2009-06-30 is the 2008 crisis. every is week (default), month or quarter, one reading per period (its last Friday); more than 160 readings step up to months, then quarters.
name: get_tremor_history
title: Get tremor history
